verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Teams platform docs name Incoming Webhooks as a first-party feature for posting messages from apps into Teams, and say webhooks connect web services to channels. This is the story's exact capability. A community comment (ms-teams-comm-11) says Teams integration is heavier than Slack's simple webhooks, but it is general sentiment rather than a concrete failure of incoming webhooks, so it lowers confidence only. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the webhook-URL setup and payload format, confirmation that posting is a simple unauthenticated URL call, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL

citations.quote: Incoming Webhooks help in posting messages from apps to Teams.
